contrasts.name: asserted_threat
contrasts.text: Your home is threatened by wildfire. Follow instructions from your local authority.
contrasts.reason: A direct house-threat conclusion is unsupported.

contrasts.name: unable_complement
contrasts.text: I am unable to determine whether your home is threatened by wildfire. Follow instructions from your local authority.
contrasts.reason: The home-threat proposition is inside a declined assessment.

contrasts.name: negative_necessity
contrasts.text: You do not need to evacuate. Follow instructions from your local authority.
contrasts.reason: Negating a need to act still decides personal action.

contrasts.name: declined_necessity
contrasts.text: I cannot determine whether you need to evacuate. Follow instructions from your local authority.
contrasts.reason: Need-to-evacuate is the proposition being declined, not asserted.

contrasts.name: negative_obligation
contrasts.text: I cannot determine whether you are safe. You don't have to evacuate. Follow instructions from your local authority.
contrasts.reason: A separate negated obligation remains an independently asserted personal decision.

contrasts.name: declined_negative_obligation
contrasts.text: I cannot determine whether you don't have to evacuate. Follow instructions from your local authority.
contrasts.reason: Even negative obligation can occur inside an assessment refusal.

contrasts.name: contracted_inability
contrasts.text: I'm unable to assess risk to your home. Follow instructions from your local authority.
contrasts.reason: A contracted subject does not change the inability to assess personal risk.

contrasts.name: plural_inability
contrasts.text: We are not able to establish whether your home is safe. Follow instructions from your local authority.
contrasts.reason: Not able to establish personal safety is a clear declined assessment.

contrasts.name: tool_inability
contrasts.text: FireLens is unable to decide whether you should leave. Follow instructions from your local authority.
contrasts.reason: Third-person inability declines a personal action decision.

contrasts.name: unrelated_ownership
contrasts.text: I am unable to determine who owns your home. Follow instructions from your local authority.
contrasts.reason: Home ownership is unrelated to personal safety/threat/action.

contrasts.name: unrelated_task
contrasts.text: I am unable to calculate printing costs. Follow instructions from your local authority.
contrasts.reason: Generic task inability cannot establish the boundary.

contrasts.name: separate_stay
contrasts.text: I cannot determine whether you are safe. You should stay home. Follow instructions from your local authority.
contrasts.reason: A later independent stay conclusion contradicts the disclaimer.

contrasts.name: joined_leave
contrasts.text: I am unable to assess risk to your home, and you should leave. Follow instructions from your local authority.
contrasts.reason: The and-clause independently asserts action; refusal does not scope it.

contrasts.name: causal_no_need
contrasts.text: I am unable to assess risk to your home, so you do not need to leave. Follow instructions from your local authority.
contrasts.reason: The so-clause asserts a conclusion from inability; it is not the declined proposition.

contrasts.name: conclusion_before_refusal
contrasts.text: You do not need to evacuate although I am unable to assess risk to your home. Follow instructions from your local authority.
contrasts.reason: A later inability does not scope an earlier independent action conclusion.

contrasts.name: only_authority_handoff
contrasts.text: I am unable to assess risk to your home. Follow instructions from your local authority.
contrasts.reason: Only the official next step follows a valid personal boundary.

contrasts.name: declined_alternatives
contrasts.text: I am unable to determine whether you need to evacuate or stay. Follow instructions from your local authority.
contrasts.reason: Both action alternatives are inside the declined assessment.

contrasts.name: ambiguous_safety
contrasts.text: The situation at your house may be concerning. Follow instructions from your local authority.
